The QM-Series Universal Testing Machines are budget-friendly tensile and compression testers loaded with advanced features, ergonomic design, and superior quality, ensuring ease of maintenance. Designed for diverse applications, the QM Universal Testing Machine line is perfect for production lines requiring quick and efficient testing and testing lab environments where advanced software enables detailed analysis, control, and management of test data.
Versatility of Universal Testing Machines
A Universal Testing Machine (UTM), also known as a Tensile Tester or Compression Tester, evaluates both tensile and compressive strengths of materials. UTMs are named for their ability to perform various tests on a wide range of materials, components, and structures. These modular machines can be customized to meet specific customer needs.
UTMs accommodate various materials, from hard samples like metals and concrete to flexible samples like rubber and textiles, making them applicable across virtually any manufacturing industry. These versatile machines can assess material properties such as tensile strength, elasticity, compression, yield strength, deformation, bend compression, and strain hardening. Models range in load capacity from 500N or 2 kN (112 lb.f / 450 lb.f) to 3,000 kN (675,000 lb.f Hydraulic Models).
Key Features of QM-Series Universal Testing Machines
Precision Components: Equipped with precision reducers and ball screws to minimize noise and transmission losses while enhancing transmission efficiency.
Durable Design: Seal plate mining anode hardening protects the ball screw, extending the instrument’s service life and precision.
Smart Load Cell: Features a memory lock function that memorizes various parameters, with plug-and-play capability.
Expandable Functions: External I/O signal contacts enable expansion of various functions.
Easy Operation: Jog control simplifies machine operation.
Versatile Testing: Perform numerous tests with optional grips and extensometers or fixtures.
Control Software
The QM-Series Universal Testing Machines come with a full-featured, easy-to-use software designed to handle various testing needs. The software includes pre-set test cycles for compression, tensile, and cyclical testing, aligning with multiple testing standards.
Software Capabilities:
Multilingual Interface: Selection of communication language.
Test Methods: Setting and execution of test methods.
Result Analysis: Analysis and printing of test results and certificates.
Graphical Analysis: Graphic post-analysis and statistical analysis of tests.
Custom Testing: Create and customize tests, certificates, and print options.
Controller Options
Qualitest offers three levels of controllers for QM-Series Universal Testing Machines, each catering to different needs:
D2 Controllers: Value options featuring simpler operation for material testing, real-time data display, and export capabilities to EXCEL for further analysis. Customizable based on user requirements.
M1F Controllers: Intermediate controllers offering smarter operation and higher efficiency, with real-time data recording and export capabilities. Open for user software customization.
M2F Controllers: Advanced controllers for demanding tests, providing extensive programming options and real-time data management. Highly customizable to meet specific user requirements.
Upgrade to the QM-Series Universal Testing Machines for a cost-effective, versatile solution to all your tensile and compression testing needs. Ideal for both production lines and testing laboratories, these machines provide precise, reliable results with easy operation and advanced software support.
